hero.headline_html:
Build Customer Trust with
Real-Time Transaction Visibility
hero.subheadline: Customer-facing displays that show real time transaction details, keeping every checkout transparent.

about.text_html: Customers want to see what they're being charged. A2Z customer screens give shoppers a clear, real-time view of every item scanned, every discount applied, and every total calculated, right at the point of sale. It's a simple addition that builds customer confidence, and gives your store a modern, professional feel.

features.title: Real-Time Transaction Display
features.description: Every item, price, and discount appears on screen as it's scanned. No surprises at the total.
